description: POST /api/stock for a new unique (sku, location) returns 200 with the filed sku, location, quantity, tracking_code and created=true
POST /api/stock with a brand-new never-seen location is accepted with 200 rather than rejected
POST /api/stock omitting sku returns 422 with an error naming the sku field
POST /api/stock omitting location returns 422 with an error naming the location field
POST /api/stock omitting quantity returns 422 with an error naming the quantity field
POST /api/stock with a negative quantity returns 422 naming the quantity field and stores no record retrievable by GET
POST /api/stock with a null tracking_code is accepted with 200 and the record reads back with tracking_code null
GET /api/stock for a filed (sku, location) returns 200 with the same sku, location, quantity and tracking_code that were filed
GET /api/stock for a (sku, location) with no record returns 404 with a detail message
GET /api/locations includes a location after stock is filed there
GET /api/stock returns only the requested pair's record when the same sku is filed at two different locations
Re-filing an existing (sku, location) with a new quantity returns 200 with created=false, never a 4xx or 5xx
After re-filing an existing (sku, location), GET returns the new quantity and new tracking_code (updated in place)
Filing the same (sku, location) twice leaves exactly one record for the pair, with a single occurrence of the location in GET /api/locations
Filing the same SKU at two different locations yields two coexisting records, each independently retrievable with its own quantity
Filing two different SKUs at the same location yields two coexisting records, each independently retrievable with its own quantity
